description: This file contains test cases for session identifier helper functions related to ACP (Agent Control Protocol) session management, using the 'vitest' testing framework. It tests functions that resolve session details, CLI hints, and current working directory logic based on session metadata.

methods.name: resolveAcpSessionCwd
methods.description: Resolves the current working directory for an ACP session based on runtime options and legacy metadata.

methods.name: resolveAcpSessionIdentifierLinesFromIdentity
methods.description: Generates session identifier lines for display, depending on the session's identity state.

methods.name: resolveAcpThreadSessionDetailLines
methods.description: Produces detailed lines about the ACP thread session, including hints for resuming or pending states.
